fieldValues.body:
- Canon now in one place: srs-context concept cc05d4c9, rewritten from the owner's words with each vignette cited, beside the Pattern Grid (srs docs/charter/decision-compass.md).
- An srs-context trap (dfacefd2, in the brief) and a bench task test that agents cite the canon instead of re-deriving it.
